capabilities.title: Factor 1: Define behavior as natural language → structured tool calls, not free-form prose
capabilities.sourceEvidence: 12-factor-agents factor 1: natural language should produce deterministic tool-call plans
capabilities.reason: Nexus agents produce structured JSON tool calls but do not enforce a declarative tool-plan schema at the boundary.

capabilities.title: Factor 2: Own the control flow — orchestration logic lives in code, not in LLM prompts
capabilities.sourceEvidence: 12-factor-agents factor 2: put loops, branches, and retries in deterministic code
capabilities.reason: Nexus ORBIT and skill runners handle orchestration in prompts; externalizing control flow to TypeScript is partially done but not systematic.

capabilities.title: Factor 3: Manage the context window explicitly — inject only what the agent needs
capabilities.reason: Nexus buildLiveContext assembles context but does not enforce a hard budget or trim policy per agent run.

capabilities.title: Factor 4: Treat tools as structured outputs — validate schema before execution
capabilities.sourceEvidence: 12-factor-agents factor 4: tool arguments are validated, not trusted raw
capabilities.reason: Nexus tool policy validates capability names but does not enforce a JSON schema on tool argument payloads.

capabilities.title: Factor 5: Keep all agent state in a single structured object (no ambient globals)
capabilities.sourceEvidence: 12-factor-agents factor 5: execution state is explicit and serializable
capabilities.reason: Nexus uses Zustand for UI state and separate lib modules for agent state; a unified serializable agent execution record is not implemented.

capabilities.title: Factor 6: Pause and ask humans at decision points — approval gates before irreversible actions
capabilities.reason: Nexus has mutation gates in toolCapabilityPolicy.ts and pre-tool-use hook but no structured pause-and-ask workflow for arbitrary agent decisions.

capabilities.title: Factor 7: Design agent steps as stateless reducers — input + state → output + new state
capabilities.sourceEvidence: 12-factor-agents factor 7: pure reducer model for agent steps
capabilities.reason: Nexus agent steps have side effects (API calls, file writes); pure reducer isolation not yet applied.

capabilities.title: Factor 8: Persist a durable execution log — resume from any checkpoint after failure
capabilities.sourceEvidence: 12-factor-agents factor 8: checkpointed execution for long-running agents
capabilities.reason: Nexus feynmanContinuity.ts provides session resume for research agents but not a general agent execution checkpoint.

capabilities.title: Factor 9: Treat agents as functions — callable, composable, testable units
capabilities.sourceEvidence: 12-factor-agents factor 9: agents are pure functions, not global singletons
capabilities.reason: Nexus agent.ts is a singleton; function-style composable agent units not yet adopted.

capabilities.title: Factor 10: Build small, focused agents — one agent per concern, not monolithic
capabilities.reason: Nexus skill runner is evolving toward focused agents; formal decomposition policy not yet enforced.

capabilities.title: Factor 11: Trigger agents from any event source — HTTP, queue, schedule, UI
capabilities.reason: Nexus agents are triggered via UI; queue and schedule invocation patterns not yet implemented.

capabilities.title: Factor 12: Deliver agent output where users already are — Slack, email, web, terminal
capabilities.reason: Nexus delivers all output to the dashboard UI; alternative output channels not yet implemented.
